edha: [ edha + a.] (pu) CL=7 [Edha vuddhiyaṃ,a. Evati vaḍḍhati etena pāvakoti edho. Indanaṃ. Nīti, dhā. 108.] Inflammable material. Fuel. (In Abhidhāna, ṭīkā. 36, Edhayatīti idho).
edhanthi: [ edha + a + anti ]  CL=9 (They) gain or attain. See - Edhiti 1 (1).
edhantu: [ edha + a + antu ]  CL=9 May they cause to enjoy or experience. See - Edhati 1 (2).
edhati: [ edha + a + ti ] (kri) CL=7 (1) Attains or gets. (2) Enjoys. (3) Reaches. (4) Propers.
[ edha + ṇe + a + ti.]  CL=9 Causative suffix is dropped. ] causes to grow; developes.
edhita: [ edha + ṇe + ta.]  CL=9 Causative suffix is dropped.] one who is caused to grow.
edhittha: [ edha + ttha ]  CL=9 Arrived or reached. See - Edhati 1 - (3).
edhiyya: [ edha + ṇaya + tvā ]  CL=9 Having caused to prosper or having developed. (Sya).
edikkha: [ eta + disa(dusa) + kvi ] (ti) CL=7 Should concentrate and contemplate like this.
edisa: [ eta + disa(dusa) + kvi.] (ti) CL=7 [Kaccaññaḥ. 462. Etamiva naṃ passati, eso viya dissatīti vā ediso. Rū. 588. Nīti,suttha. 1269. In Thī edisī. Īdasၐ(saṃ)] (Person, dhamma, etc) that should meditate like this. (Person, dhamma, etc.,) that should think like this. (Person, dhamma, etc.,) that has this nature.
edisaka: [ edisa + ka ] (ti) CL=7 One who has this nature.
edisika: [ edisa + ika ] (ti) CL=7 (Something) has this nature.
edī: [ eta + disa (dusa) + kvi ] (ti) CL=7 (Someone) should meditate like that. See - Edikkha.
